t: This is Moreton House, a detached house on Holly Walk in Hampstead, in the London Borough of Camden. It has been listed Grade II on the National Heritage List for England since December 1969. It was designed by Thomas Garner, one of the leading English Gothic Revival architects of the Victorian era. He is known for his partnership of almost thirty years with the architect George Frederick Bodley. So the house comes from the hand of a significant Victorian architect.
